_readme: Each equity seed and its matched control: the shared turns carry byte-identical texts in every arm (the clinical course), the other turns carry the barrier details (language, distance, cost) only in the equity seed. On clause_removed_turns the control text is the equity text with the equity clause deleted and nothing else changed, so the clinical exposure stays the same. pivot_turn is the only turn whose context role is evidence. warning_signs are the scenario's warning-sign terms in every register: an affirmed one (no negation cue earlier in its sentence) appears at the pivot turn only.

pairs.barrier: a language barrier (Spanish first language, no interpreter, a husband who translates)
rural distance (70 miles to the nearest hospital, an hour for an ambulance, no neighbor close by)
medication and care cost (insulin pens at $300 before the deductible, fear of an emergency bill)
